protocol.name: retained-second-round-N2-no-fit-to-test
protocol.margin_rationale: Zero added margin: descriptive derivation maxima, no invented positive reserve and no heldout fitting
protocol.health_rationale: Unchanged historical synthetic 0.01 per-axis variance ceilings; diagnostic comparison, not justified runtime health
protocol.workload: Exact retained inputs and entire post-warmup windows; historical full traces previously reviewed; not unseen or blinded

freeze_scope: membership and protocol frozen before this evaluation; historical data not untouched
truth_velocity_policy: Prefer matching independent twist if present; pinned Pose_V has pose only, so bracket differences are interval averages
position_scope: absolute local NED base_link origin; not capture-to-query relative error
